content:
rachel: FYI saw a small spike in SSE p95 and duplicate metering for a handful of EU tenants after we flipped the new route cooldown flag.
omar: Which flag exactly? the route-cooldown-ms change?
rachel: yes, cooldown lowered from 400ms -> 100ms to reduce tail latency. After flip we observed brief route flip-flops when primary returned late, clients reconnected and got billed twice.
kai: Do we have logs correlating route swaps and metering events?
rachel: snippet:
```
[12:11:02] route: candidate=primary accept=delayed err=timeout
[12:11:02] route: fallback chosen id=pool-B reason=accept_timeout
[12:11:02] client: reconnect start token=rt-xx
[12:11:03] primary: late_accept conn=abc
[12:11:03] route: swapped back -> duplicate resume observed
[12:11:03] metering: conn_open tenant=delta tokens=1.0
[12:11:03] metering: conn_open tenant=delta tokens=1.0  # duplicate
```
console-team: Our sampling for resume + metering is 1% which makes debugging tricky. I can bump to 10% for affected tenant group for 15m.
omar: Root cause seems to be too-short cooldown allowing re-eval after late accept. Proposal: increase route_cooldown_ms to 300ms for resume paths, and add token-level idempotency tagging for resume flows so metering can collapse duplicates.
kai: Config sketch:
```
routing:
  resume_cooldown_ms: 300
  resume_idempotency_tag: resume_token
metering:
  collapse_on_tag: resume_token
```
billing-svc: We can collapse metering events if they share resume_token and occur within 500ms. We'll add a short dedupe buffer keyed by (tenant, resume_token). Needs proto to include resume_token on metering events.
console-team: Also request: transient sampling override when cooldown config changes. If we flip the cooldown we should auto-bump sampling for 10m for the affected route-id so ops can see before full rollout.
omar: Rollout plan: feature flag resume_cooldown_v2. Start 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. During first three steps enable console sampling override. Don't enable billing collapse until resume_idempotency_tag is present.achel: Tests: unit for debounce window, integration test with simulated late-accept primary, and e2e metering check to ensure collapse works.
deploy-bot: queued: routing:feature/resume-cooldown -> staging at 13:05.
console-team: I'll add alert: if metering.duplicate_tokens_delta > 2/min and route.swap.rate > 5/min -> page. Also adding temp sampling bump now.
ka i: small nit: ensure SDKs aren't relying on immediate reopens; adding debounce might increase perceived reconnect latency by ~200ms. We'll document in changelog.
omar: Agreed. Action items summary:
- omar: PR for resume_cooldown + tests
- billing-svc: proto change + dedupe buffer (RFC)
- console-team: sampling override + alert (PR)
- rachel: run canary and collect 30m traces
rachel: thanks all. If we see >3 duplicate resume events/min during canary we rollback. :eyes:
